host.ask: PC running Octet BLI Discovery (the automation interface listens there)
host.help: In Octet BLI Discovery: File > Options > Automation, choose TCP/IP and note the port; tick Localhost only if this package runs on the same PC.

port.ask: TCP port set in the Automation options

method_dir.ask: Folder on the Octet PC holding the method files (.fmf) agents may run
method_dir.help: A Windows path as the Octet PC sees it; the interface opens methods by that path.

allowed_methods.ask: Method file names an agent may run (JSON list; empty = any in the folder)

max_run_hours.ask: Longest run before the job is failed
